messages.text: For a Wireless Communication use case involving Wi-Fi 7/8, where would Signaling / Non-signaling Tester fit in the test workflow?

| Tester type | Workflow placement | Typical purpose |
|---|---|---|
| **Signaling tester, e.g. R&S CMX500** | It is positioned for **R&D signaling / interworking testing** in the Wi‑Fi 7 R&D and production workflow.[4] | It is used to test wireless-device operation across latest-generation cellular and non-cellular standards in a single-instrument setup.[2] |
| **Signaling tester, e.g. R&S CMX500** | In Wi‑Fi 7 R&D, it is used in **signaling mode** and under **real-world conditions** to measure RF TX/RX characteristics.[2] | It supports Wi‑Fi 7-specific R&D tests such as 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery, coexistence, and E2E test capabilities.[2] |
| **Signaling tester, e.g. R&S CMX500** | It is also used for cellular/WLAN interworking scenarios such as WLAN offloading and Voice over WLAN.[6] | Its N3IWF gateway is described as enabling WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN testing, and its POLQA function supports early-stage voice-quality evaluation for Voice over WLAN applications.[6] |
| **Signaling tester, e.g. R&S CMX500** | For Wi‑Fi 8, the knowledge base records CMX500 WLAN signaling support for 802.11bn station and AP testing options.[24] | A separate Wi‑Fi 8 PR context says CMX500 was used to validate a Broadcom prototype Wi‑Fi 8 device and showcase Wi‑Fi 8 physical-layer features.[38] |
| **Non-signaling tester, e.g. R&S CMP180** | It is positioned for **production non-signaling RF testing** in the Wi‑Fi 7 R&D and production workflow.[4] | In WLAN device production, all RF measurements are performed in non-signaling mode to save time.[1] |
| **Non-signaling tester, e.g. R&S CMP180** | CMP180 is described as optimized for production-phase non-signaling RF measurements.[1] | It supports technologies including Wi‑Fi 6E, Wi‑Fi 7, and 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz with bandwidths up to 500 MHz.[1] |
| **Non-signaling tester, e.g. R&S CMP180** | For future-looking Wi‑Fi 8-related waveform work, CMP180 is described as demonstrating loopback validation of a 480 MHz WLAN waveform.[1] | That 480 MHz waveform is only described as a potential candidate for the yet-to-be-defined Wi‑Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn and is not confirmed as a formal Wi‑Fi 8 specification.[1][3] |
| **Non-signaling tester, e.g. R&S CMP180** | CMP180 can be used where multi-port production RF architecture is needed.[13] | It integrates two analyzers, two generators, and two sets of eight RF ports for single-box 2x2 MIMO testing, and two units can be combined for 4x4 MIMO access-point testing.[1] |
【推論】A practical Wi‑Fi 7/8 workflow would place CMX500 earlier for connected R&D, feature, MLO, coexistence, and interworking validation, then place CMP180 later for faster production RF measurements once the design is stable.[1][2][4][6]

answer.question: For a Wireless Communication use case involving Wi-Fi 7/8, where would a Signaling / Non-signaling Tester fit in the test workflow? Please explain placement in the workflow and typical purpose.

passages.text:
Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Production：R&S CMP180 non-signaling RF testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- WLAN device production phase 中，所有 RF measurements 以 non-signaling mode 執行以節省時間。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被定位為 optimized for this purpose 的 radio communication tester。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform。
- 來源稱 480 MHz WLAN waveform 是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate；這不是正式 Wi‑Fi 8 規格。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] integrated two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing。
- 來源稱 two [[R&S CMP180]] instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for efficient testing of 4x4 [[MIMO]] access points。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › 使用限制
- 本頁目前只由 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 支撐。
- 來源是 PR / demonstration positioning，不是正式 datasheet、configuration guide、test case list 或 certification document。
- 不可從本來源推論 [[R&S CMX500]] Wi‑Fi 7 的 option code、software release、支援 RF chains 數量、MLO link combination、measurement uncertainty 或完整 test coverage。
- 不可從本來源推論 [[R&S CMP180]] 480 MHz waveform 的正式 [[Wi-Fi 8]] 標準地位、量測規格或 production throughput。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing
[[Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 中描述的測試方案組合：以 [[R&S CMX500]] 覆蓋 R&D signaling / interworking 測試，以 [[R&S CMP180]] 覆蓋 production non-signaling RF 測試。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Wi-Fi 7 技術挑戰
來源將 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] 描述為 designed for extremely high data throughput，面向 tens of gigabits per second、low latency、ultra-high-definition video streaming、virtual reality 與 augmented reality applications。來源列出的 higher throughput key elements：

| 技術項目 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| channel bandwidth | increased channel bandwidth of 320 MHz |
| spatial streams | up to 16 spatial streams |
| modulation | 4096 QAM modulation |
| MLO | key feature；使 multiple RF chains 測試環境變重要 |

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Interworking：WLAN offloading 與 Voice over WLAN
同一來源也把 [[R&S CMX500]] 用於 cellular [[5G]] 與 [[WLAN]] 的 seamless traffic offloading and interworking demonstration：

- [[WLAN offloading]] 是把原本 intended for cellular networks 的 data 透過 WLAN 傳送，以減少 cellular bands data load。
- [[Voice over WLAN]] 情境聚焦在 cellular network 與 WLAN 之間 handover during a voice call，以維持 uninterrupted voice call experience。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 內建 newly integrated [[N3IWF]] gateway，可測試 WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 integrated [[POLQA]] voice quality measurement function 可用於 voice over WLAN applications 的 quality of experience early-stage 評估。

Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024 › 關鍵實體與概念
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]]：新聞稿發布者與測試解決方案供應商。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz GmbH & Co KG]]：frontmatter author 與 R&S registered trademark 所屬公司名。
- [[R&S CMX500]]：R&D single-box signaling tester；本來源新增 Wi‑Fi 7 test functionality、WLAN offloading、N3IWF 與 POLQA voice quality measurement 的 PR 語境。
- [[R&S CMP180]]：production / R&D non-signaling tester；本來源宣稱支援 Wi-Fi 6E、Wi-Fi 7、5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz、bandwidths up to 500 MHz，並展示 480 MHz WLAN waveform loopback。
- [[Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing]]：本來源的主題概念，區分 CMX500 R&D signaling 與 CMP180 production non-signaling 測試。
- [[WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN]]：本來源描述的 CMX500 single-box interworking / voice continuity 測試情境。
- [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]]：來源列出 320 MHz channel bandwidth、up to 16 spatial streams、4096 QAM、低延遲與 high throughput。
- [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]]：來源稱 yet-to-be-defined，且 wider channel bandwidths are in discussion；CMP180 480 MHz waveform 被稱為 potential waveform candidate。
- [[MLO]]：Wi-Fi 7 key feature，使 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 變重要。
- [[N3IWF]]：Non-3GPP Interworking Function gateway；來源稱 newly integrated in R&S CMX500。
- [[POLQA]]：來源稱 R&S CMX500 integrated POLQA voice quality measurement function 可用於 Voice over WLAN applications。
- [[MWC 2024]]：展示場合。
- [[Christian Mokry]]：Press & media contact。

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 進一步說明，[[Bluetest]] 已將 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 的 4G 與 [[5G NR]] test functionality 整合進 [[Bluetest Flow]] v1.18，並將 [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality 擴充為支援 320 MHz bandwidth。此來源將整合後的能力描述為可在 [[Bluetest]] RTS 中使用單一 tester 與 reverberation test system 驗證 WiFi、[[LTE]]、5G SA / NSA 的 radio and antenna performance。

來源中的 [[Kjell Olovsson]] 引言稱，將 [[R&S CMX500]] one-box tester 整合到 [[Bluetest Flow]] broadens Bluetest 的 WLAN testing capabilities，並可為 latest Wi-Fi 7 devices 提供 testing environment。

來源中的 [[Karl-Johan Holm]] 引言稱，[[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 與 [[Bluetest Flow]] 讓 developers 可在 Bluetest reverberation chambers 中從 WiFi 到 LTE 與 5G SA/NSA 驗證 radio and antenna performance，且此 path 是 end-to-end、fast、repeatable。

⚠️ [[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）說 Bluetest CEO 是 [[Karl-Johan Holm]]，但既有頁面 [[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]] 說 Bluetest CEO 是 [[Kjell Olovsson]]。兩份來源皆未標示新聞稿發布日期且 raw created 同為 2026-09-11，無法判斷哪一個較新；並列保留，不推論職務變動。

電信技術中心 › 來源中的機構描述
[[低軌衛星通信終端設備技術規範與相關檢測]]（來源標示 111年08月）在「電信技術中心之發展簡介與願景」中說：

- 財團法人電信技術中心之設立，緣於前電信監理機關（交通部電信總局）為因應數位科技匯流，掌握資訊、通訊與產業發展動向，確保我國資通訊監理政策及法令符合國際發展趨勢，於 93年2月成立本中心。

- 來源亦稱其協助促進國際電信組織間交流與合作、保護消費者權益，以健全電信事業發展及市場交易安全。

[[WaveStudio Software Suite]] 是 [[MVG]] 的 software suite；依 [[MVG integrates CMX500 OBT into WaveStudio Software Suite, simplifying 5G OTA signaling test processes]]，它已整合 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]]，使 [[MVG]] antenna measurement systems 可直接執行 [[5G NR]] 與 [[LTE]] OTA signaling testing。依 [[MVG OTA test systems now support full WLAN OTA signaling testing alongside cellular coverage with CMX500 OBT from Rohde & Schwarz]]，此整合已擴充到 full [[WLAN]] OTA signaling testing，包括 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] access point and station testing functionality，並新增 [[5G NR Non-Standalone]]（[[EN-DC]]）testing support。

Bluetest Flow › 與 R&S CMX500 / CMX500 OBT 的關係
[[Bluetest Flow]] 在來源中扮演測試環境控制軟體：

- 控制 / 操作 [[Bluetest]] reverberation test systems（RTS）。
- 依前一份來源，整合 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 [[Wi-Fi 7]] signaling / test functionality。
- 依新來源，[[Bluetest Flow]] v1.18 整合 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 的 4G 與 [[5G NR]] test functionality。
- 支援 [[Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing]]，並在新來源中擴展為 [[4G 5G NR WLAN OTA MIMO stress testing]] 的 multi-technology workflow。

R&S CMW500
R&S CMW500 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 Wideband radio communication tester；[[CMW_dat-sw_en_5213-9211-22_v1700]]（Version 17.00，April 2023）列出的訂購型號為 R&S®CMW500，Order No. 1201.0002K50；[[CMW-KA096_PanEUNGeCall_TC_Status]]（Oct. 2024，文件版次來源未標示）補充其搭配 [[R&S CMW-KA096]] 或 [[R&S CMWrun KT111]] 時的 [[NGeCall over LTE]] 測試支援狀態。

R&S PCB test solutions › 來源中的說法
[[0 Digital Test - What are SIPI and Serdes]]（封面日期 2026.3.4）Slide 21 題為 **R&S PCB test solutions**，副標為 **PCB Fabricator and System House**，列出以下流程與項目：

- **Material Measurement**：Impedance ([[TDR]])、DK/DF extraction。
- **Material/Stackup selection**：IL、DK/DF、roughness、impedance、Xtalk、TL modeling、Eye diagram。
- **Signal Integrity modeling/testing**：IL、DK/DF、roughness、impedance。
- **Sampling testing**：IL、DK/DF、impedance。
- **PL/Process Monitoring**：來源列在同一流程上，但未展開 PL。
- 圖上另列 [[SPEAG]]、[[SWISSTO12]]、[[QWED]]、[[KEYCOM]]、[[RSTW]]、TDR、Delta-L、ISD/ADK、ISD/ADK、w/ cable / connector testing 等文字。

MediaTek M80 › unresolved

無線通訊認證實驗室資料清單 › 使用限制
- 不可把 [[Test House]] 的 OneNote 連結標題解讀為已驗證的實驗室能力、測試範圍或市場資訊。

- 不可把 RF / EMC 測試 3–4 週、GMA 8–12 週解讀為任何產品的保證交期。
- [[低軌衛星通信終端設備技術規範與相關檢測]]中的 TTC CATR 能力是 111年08月簡報層級說法；不可取代 TTC 官方能力清單、TAF 認證範圍、測試報告或正式報價文件。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Production：R&S CMP180 non-signaling RF testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- WLAN device production phase 中，所有 RF measurements 以 non-signaling mode 執行以節省時間。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被定位為 optimized for this purpose 的 radio communication tester。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform。
- 來源稱 480 MHz WLAN waveform 是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate；這不是正式 Wi‑Fi 8 規格。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] integrated two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing。
- 來源稱 two [[R&S CMP180]] instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for efficient testing of 4x4 [[MIMO]] access points。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › 使用限制
- 本頁目前只由 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 支撐。
- 來源是 PR / demonstration positioning，不是正式 datasheet、configuration guide、test case list 或 certification document。
- 不可從本來源推論 [[R&S CMX500]] Wi‑Fi 7 的 option code、software release、支援 RF chains 數量、MLO link combination、measurement uncertainty 或完整 test coverage。
- 不可從本來源推論 [[R&S CMP180]] 480 MHz waveform 的正式 [[Wi-Fi 8]] 標準地位、量測規格或 production throughput。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing
[[Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 中描述的測試方案組合：以 [[R&S CMX500]] 覆蓋 R&D signaling / interworking 測試，以 [[R&S CMP180]] 覆蓋 production non-signaling RF 測試。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Interworking：WLAN offloading 與 Voice over WLAN
同一來源也把 [[R&S CMX500]] 用於 cellular [[5G]] 與 [[WLAN]] 的 seamless traffic offloading and interworking demonstration：

- [[WLAN offloading]] 是把原本 intended for cellular networks 的 data 透過 WLAN 傳送，以減少 cellular bands data load。
- [[Voice over WLAN]] 情境聚焦在 cellular network 與 WLAN 之間 handover during a voice call，以維持 uninterrupted voice call experience。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 內建 newly integrated [[N3IWF]] gateway，可測試 WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 integrated [[POLQA]] voice quality measurement function 可用於 voice over WLAN applications 的 quality of experience early-stage 評估。

R&S CMP180 › 產品定位
[[R&S CMP180]] 是 Radio Communication Tester。依 [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]]，文件涵蓋 global options、Bluetooth、CDMA2000、GSM、LP-IoT、LTE、NB-IoT、NR、spectrum analysis、UWB、WCDMA、WLAN、[[R&S VSE]] options 與 ordering information。

依 [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]]，CMP180 支援 simultaneous receiver and transmitter testing，並提供 RF generator/analyzer no. 1 與可選 RF generator/analyzer no. 2 的多埠 RF 測試架構。
